caveats: Google's Maps pages served a limited view in this browser profile, so review counts were only visible for some businesses (A Freeman's Place 40, Rich's 1,058, Rainbow 36, Frank Alvarez 114, Gary Dominicus 176). Counts for Capobianco's ATA, Black Belt World, Luxe Core Pilates and Anton Plumbing are recorded as unknown rather than estimated.

Every page title observed in this browser carried a leading emoji character (including sites on unrelated platforms). That is treated as an artefact of the research environment, not a defect of any business's site, and is not scored against them.

Several businesses listed in batch.json without a website do in fact have one found during research: Rainbow Plumbing & Heating (rainbowplumbingnj.com), Anton Plumbing (antonplumbinghvac.com) and Frank Alvarez & Sons (frankalvarez.com). Only Gary Dominicus & Son has no website.

Phone numbers in batch.json were stale for LBS Nutrition (site and Google both show 732-210-9581, not 732-587-7551) and for Anton Plumbing at branch level (four different numbers in circulation). These are recorded as data quality issues in the relevant entries rather than corrections to the brief.
Ability-to-pay scores are judgements from public signals (review volume, locations, years in business, ticket-size of what they sell). No financial information was available for any business.
All Gary Dominicus & Son service details are inferred from its Google category, directory listings and a third-party plumber directory, since the business has no website.
data_gaps: Exact Google review counts for Capobianco's ATA, Black Belt World Taekwondo (East Brunswick), Luxe Core Pilates and Anton Plumbing Heating & Cooling.

Google Business Profile claim status could not be confirmed for any business (no owner-verified indicator was visible in the limited Maps view); owner-posted updates were used as a proxy for Capobianco's ATA, Rich's and Frank Alvarez.
Pricing for Capobianco's ATA, Black Belt World, Luxe Core Pilates, Rich's Plumbing, Rainbow Plumbing, Anton Plumbing and Frank Alvarez was not published anywhere checked.
Anton Plumbing's actual contact form could not be inspected because no form element rendered on /contact-us/ (only an about:blank iframe); it may load conditionally on a different network or device.
Luxe Core Pilates' class schedule and prices could not be observed at all - both pages render headings only, so it is unknown whether booking exists behind a members' login.
Gary Dominicus & Son has no owned web presence, so its services, licensing and staff size are unverified.
No social-only or review-platform presence (Yelp, Facebook) was audited for these businesses; only Google Maps and each company's own site.
